instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '员工申诉机制'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 员工正式申诉渠道有哪些（热线、第三方平台、HR邮箱等）？ 是否支持匿名及书面反报复保护？ 是否规定处理时限与升级至高层/董事会路径？ 机制覆盖哪些员工类型？ 是否开展知晓度培训或测评？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“欢迎提意见”；仅有客户投诉热线；仅有供应商申诉机制；仅有反歧视政策而无通用申诉渠道；区分：员工申诉机制面向员工可达性与闭环；供应商申诉面向供应商；举报人保护更偏舞弊/合规举报保护；纠正补救是违规后处置流程，不是申诉入口本身。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

In order to address customer complaints in a timely and effective manner, the Group has formulated the China Development Bank Financial Leasing Co. Ltd.'s Client Complaint Handling Measures ( 《國銀金融租賃股 份有限公司客戶投訴處理辦法》 ), and established a multi-level and all-round customer complaint receiving and handling mechanism together with offices, the Board Office, Operation and Management Department, Compliance Management Department and Legal Affairs Department. We timely respond to customer complaints to ensure that the rights and interests of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises and natural person customers are legally protected. In 2021, the inclusive finance business of the Group handled 3 complaints and the problems fed back from customers were properly solved in accordance with relevant management rules.

results.text: The Group upholds the principle of investigating into each report and fighting any form of corruption, and has well-established whistle-blowing channels and accountability mechanism. The Group encourages employees and other stakeholders to report corruption through telephone, e-mail and other channels. After receiving the reported cases of corruption and fraud, the Group will preliminarily verify the case, file the case for investigation and make the final punishment decision according to a well-established internal handling procedures for fraud cases. For tip-offs relating to the senior management, the Group will set up a special investigation team with the approval of the Board of the Company to conduct investigations, clearly demonstrate the Group's determination to strengthen discipline enforcement and accountability, and demonstrate our intolerance towards cases of corruption and fraud.

[Content]
The Group upholds the principle of investigating into each report and fighting any form of corruption, and has well-established whistle-blowing channels and accountability mechanism. The Group encourages employees and other stakeholders to report corruption through telephone, e-mail and other channels. After receiving the reported cases of corruption and fraud, the Group will preliminarily verify the case, file the case for investigation and make the final punishment decision according to a well-established internal handling procedures for fraud cases. For tip-offs relating to the senior management, the Group will set up a special investigation team with the approval of the Board of the Company to conduct investigations, clearly demonstrate the Group's determination to strengthen discipline enforcement and accountability, and demonstrate our intolerance towards cases of corruption and fraud.
